theme: Dark Mode Only - AI Trading Synthwave

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (or similar mono) for numerical data, tickers, stats, and badges
typography.rules: Preserve Inter for general body text. Enforce mono fonts for financial data to achieve the 'Bloomberg terminal' technical feel.

visual_enhancers.glass-dark: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050814]/70 border border-[#00F0FF]/15 hover:border-[#00F0FF]/40 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)] transition-colors duration-300
visual_enhancers.grids: Subtle technical grid background: `background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px;`
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop-shadows and text-shadows sparingly for active indicators and neon text.

signature_moments: 1. Hover Neon Glows: Interactive cards and buttons emit a soft cyan/electric-blue glow on hover.
2. Pulse Status Dots: Live signals and active bots use a pulsing `box-shadow` in neon green or cyan.
3. Data Flash: Subtle neon text-shadows for high-emphasis 'AI' elements to simulate terminal fluorescence.
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT touch any component JSX files, component logic, or data-testid attributes.
CRITICAL: Do NOT modify the Tampermonkey script CSS.
CRITICAL: This app is DARK MODE ONLY. Only update the `.dark` class variables or force dark mode defaults.

1. `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js`: Override the `purple` color scale to output Neon Cyan / Electric Blue shades (e.g. mapping `purple-500` to `#00F0FF`). This ensures all existing JSX using `bg-purple-500` automatically adopts the new AI trading theme. Also override `slate` or background colors to a deep blue-navy scale (`#02040A` to `#0B132B`).

2. `/app/frontend/src/index.css`: Update the CSS variables for the shadcn theme in the `.dark` block. Map `--background` to deep void navy, `--primary` to neon cyan, etc. Preserve standard red/green hexes for `--destructive` and success.
3. `/app/frontend/src/App.css`: Replace the global slate background gradient on `.trading-app` or `body` with a deep navy gradient plus the subtle grid pattern.
4. `/app/frontend/src/App.css`: Update the `.glass-dark` class to match the requested synthwave/AI terminal feel (darker background, cyan tinted border, hover glow).
5. `/app/frontend/src/App.css`: Add helper classes like `.neon-text` (adds text-shadow), `.neon-border`, and `.pulse-status-dot`.
6. Verify that AssetPicker's semantic colors (blue for Regular, green for OTC) are maintained.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal transition 'all'. Avoid purely flat slate backgrounds; use deep navy for depth. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers. Ensure all interactive elements have highly visible, glowing hover/focus states to match the cyber/trading aesthetic.
